subject: Control System
questionText:
Consider the following statements, the roots of the
characteristic equation of a control system lead to
instability, if they lie
(1) Multiple roots on the imaginary axis of the
s-plane.
(2) On the negative real axis of the s-plane
(3) On the right-half of the s-plane
Which of the above are correct? 
(a)
1, 2, 3
(b) 1 & 2
(c)
2 & 3
(d) 1 & 3
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-09 (Routh Hurwitz Criteria - (Part- 1&2)).
